messages:
emma: Heads up — PR gating eval workflow is flaking (GH Actions -> Buildkite bridge). Several PRs are blocked because the eval runner times out when BK agents are being scaled down.

miguel: Seen it too. Started after we merged the gha-parallel-refactor last week? Failures show 'buildkite: runner not found' followed by long wait then timeout.

sara: Nightly schedules also had one of the heavy eval shards fail and artifacts missing. I checked the BK pipeline: job succeeded but upload step errored intermittently. :confused: 

ops-bot: [ALERT] pipeline red — evals/nightly/2026-03-20-02: auto-retry triggered (2/3). Link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/pipelines/evals/builds/4723

jon: Workaround for PRs: you can rerun the GH Action job manually but that's annoying at scale. We should avoid manual reruns.

ci-infra: Investigating. Early hypothesis: autoscaler is terminating ephemeral BK agents when CPU < threshold while GH Action still holds the job. That causes the BK side to report 'runner not found' and GH action to hang waiting for status.

buildkite-bot: Triggered pipeline 4724 for PR #1427 (eval-lite smoke). See pipeline: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/pipelines/evals/builds/4724

emma: Two short-term options: 1) add a retry wrapper around the GHA -> BK bridge so transient runner not found is retried with backoff; 2) move heavy eval shards off the PR gate to nightly and keep a lightweight smoke eval for PRs. I'm leaning to both.

miguel: Agree. For the retry wrapper, something like: 
```bash
# in gha step
for i in 1 2 3; do 
  if run_eval_bridge; then break; fi
  sleep $((2**i));
done
```
That should cover intermittent agent death without masking real regressions.

sara: For PR gating we must preserve quality checks — smoke tests should catch obvious regressions (latency blowups, huge output diffs). Nightly can run full evals+quant experiments.

jon: I can own the smoke test harness + dashboard tile. Plan: implement a small prompt set (~50 cases) that runs under 30s and reports mean latency + a cheap quality metric. Will add PR checks to fail on >X% regression.

ci-infra: I'll temporarily increase BK agent TTL and add a safety buffer to autoscaler for eval pipelines. Also going to add a health-check probe that prevents termination while GH Actions hold the job. Will open infra PR and ping here.

emma: Sounds good. Can we also add a GH Action buildkite link + pipeline id in the log on failure so triage is faster? Right now logs are vague.

miguel: I'll update the GH Action to emit BK build url and job id on start/failure. Also adding `continue-on-error: false` explicitly and gating logic to ensure PRs still block on smoke eval failures.

sara: Can we schedule a short post-mortem if we see >3 flakey eval failures in a week? Keep it lightweight.

ci-infra: Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/289 — increases ttl and adds probe (WIP). Will update PR with revised autoscaler conf and tests.

emma: Thanks all. Next actions: jon -> smoke harness + dashboard, miguel -> gha emit & retry wrapper, ci-infra -> bk autoscaler patch, sara -> finalize smoke metric thresholds. Ping here when PRs are ready and we can flip the gate. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: nightly evals will run at 02:00 UTC. Change window if needed.

buildkite-bot: Artifact upload logs for build 4723: https://storage.redwood/data/evals/4723/logs.tar.gz

jon: I'll prototype the smoke set today and open a draft PR against evals/harness.

miguel: Marking this thread with label `evals-ci-flakey-runner`. Will follow up with a link to the GH Actions workflow diff.

sara: Thanks — moving heavy evals to nightly should reduce cost spikes too.

emma: Closing loop: once infra PR is merged and smoke harness lands, we'll re-evaluate gating. If flakiness drops, we'll keep it; if not, we'll add stricter BK-side guards.
